verdict.rationale: CSC's entity management documentation claims AI-assisted bulk document imports with automated entity and folder routing. That is a real but narrow bulk capability limited to document ingestion. Its 45-day report covering every entity with an upcoming filing is portfolio-wide reporting, not a bulk action. The secure APIs it mentions have no published spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), so programmatic bulk operations are unproven. Missing for 10: bulk edit/update actions across many entities or records, documented bulk API endpoints, bulk filing or other bulk actions beyond document import, independent or hands-on corroboration.
